questions.question: Describe your firm's ESG integration process.
questions.answer: We integrate ESG factors into every investment decision through a documented screening step.

questions.question: How do you engage with portfolio companies on climate?
questions.answer: We run annual engagement meetings on climate targets with all portfolio companies.

questions.question: What is your policy on human rights and labour standards?
questions.answer: Our human rights policy follows the UN Guiding Principles and is reviewed yearly.

questions.question: Do you report climate risks in line with the TCFD recommendations?
questions.answer: Yes, our annual report follows the TCFD recommendations on climate-related disclosure.

questions.question: What were your Scope 3 emissions in 2025?
Describe your board's diversity and independence.
questions.answer: Our board has seven members, four of them independent.

questions.question: How is your firm regulated?
questions.answer: We are authorised and regulated by the national financial supervisor.

questions.question: Describe your data security and cybersecurity controls.
questions.answer: We hold ISO 27001 certification and test our controls each year.

questions.question: Provide your assets under management by strategy.
How do you assess governance at investee companies?
questions.answer: Governance is scored on board structure, pay and shareholder rights.
